purpose: Continue final closure after direct Omgevingsplan sweep; resolve remaining true legal/future-law residuals where current official evidence permits.

records.result: The former 2024 Beleidsregels kamerverhuur en woningsplitsen are confirmed expired as of 20-02-2026. A current 2026 Omgevingsplan participation policy is in force, confirming active Omgevingswet governance. The expired 2024 policy must not be presented as current law. Until a successor housing-specific policy is positively found, actual permission is determined from the current Omgevingsplan/address/activity route.
closed: do not use expired policy as current substantive rule
remainingAllowedOnly: successor policy watch if later officially published

records.result: Current Omgevingsplan and current 2026 woningsplitsing policy already close the splitting regime. A final targeted search did not establish a separate current opkoopbescherming regime or standalone municipality-wide ordinary-room-rental policy from official public sources. These are therefore not assumed to exist. Ordinary room rental remains an address/use current-plan question; opkoopbescherming is recorded as no positive current municipal regime found after repeated official-source search, not as an affirmative prohibition/permission rule.
remainingAllowedOnly: address/use current-plan outcome for ordinary room rental
future-law watch for any later opkoopbescherming/housing regulation

records.result: Current Omgevingsplan explicitly closes the woningsplitsing legal framework. Final targeted search did not positively establish a separate current opkoopbescherming regime or standalone municipality-wide ordinary-room-rental policy. No such regime is invented. Ordinary room rental is reduced to address/use current-plan analysis and any later specific policy publication.
remainingAllowedOnly: future-law watch for later housing-stock/opkoop instrument

records.result: Important promotion from future-law signal to current-law track: an official municipal B&W/raadsvoorstel and draft raadsbesluit for proposal 2025-1075 explicitly proposes adoption of Huisvestingsverordening Deventer 2026, withdrawal of the 2022 regulation, general entry into force after publication and entry of the affordable-new-build purchase-permit chapter on 1 June 2026. The municipality's current public documents index still lists the 'Vaststelling Huisvestingsverordening Deventer 2026' dossier. Because the retrieved document is a proposal/draft decision rather than the signed/publication record itself, the status is upgraded from mere consultation draft to 'formal adoption dossier located; final publication verification required'.

futureSignal.new: formal adoption proposal/draft council decision located
futureSignal.next: locate signed council decision or published CVDR/Gemeenteblad version and compare final text

records.result: Final current-source check still shows the municipality describing Huisvestingsverordening Brummen 2026 as concept after consultation, with council decision expected after processing responses. The concept text itself contains substantive future rules on housing-stock changes including splitting, inwoning and conversion to (non-)self-contained housing. It remains a valuable future-law signal but is not promoted to current law without a positive adoption publication.

futureSignal.next: check council agenda/decision and Lokale Regelgeving for adopted publication

summary.keyResult: Baarle-Nassau expired-policy ambiguity is closed; Borger-Odoorn and Bronckhorst no longer carry vague legal-source gaps; Deventer has progressed from consultation draft to formal adoption dossier; Brummen remains an explicit monitored concept rather than an unexplained open item.
